title: Qualify complete Android Gallery
requires: Physical Android Vulkan device and adb access
scope: Run revision-pinned scene, control, lifecycle, rendering, memory, thermal and sustained-runtime checks for the complete capability-driven Android Gallery.
acceptance: Every selectable scene passes its declared controls, reset, background recovery and sustained frame checks on identified hardware; unavailable scenes match driver capability records.
Tracked evidence separates physics correctness, visual execution and performance and records APK, driver, source and toolchain hashes.

history.reason: Qualified all 28 Android Vulkan Gallery scenes, controls and lifecycle on Pixel 7; published direct-presentation, thermal, UI and explicit sub-target performance evidence
